parsed.why: State targeting of perceived queer visitors: documented deportation of foreign nationals without charges, dating-app entrapment with trans women as targets, coerced exams, torture in custody, media incitement. Organised targeting tier.

14-year sodomy statute, police-perpetrated rape and violence against trans people, impunity, no recognition or recourse; sanctuary village is social, not legal. Structural criminalisation plus hostile policing.

No trans-specific criminal exposure, screening, or facility ban documented; strong anti-discrimination machinery and visible acceptance. ID-marker mismatch is a resident gap; friction is moderate, not exposure.

Enforced criminalisation since 2017, police refuse to protect LGBTQ victims, civil society reports dozens imprisoned, no LGR, pervasive social hostility with weak recourse; law and society both adverse to an outed visitor.

Legal, LGR available, anti-discrimination law (though weakly enforced), no state targeting; episodic pride hostility and under-recorded violence, but institutions investigated attacks and officials condemned — Reduced Risk.
